map.name: Fall of the Pillager Level 1
map.testedVersion: Static source audit only; runtime not executed

bugs.title: Co-op players can damage each other during normal combat
bugs.problem: Players assigned to the same cooperative offense session can damage one another with normal combat, allowing teammate attacks to feed the knockdown/death lifecycle.
bugs.expected: Members of the same cooperative arena/session cannot damage one another unless friendly fire is explicitly authored as a gameplay mechanic.
bugs.observed: The selected player entity retains normal attack/damage behavior and no same-session friendly-fire cancellation is installed. The custom damage lifecycle handles fatal/knockdown behavior but does not reject damage sourced from another member of the same session.
reproduction: Join the same Fall of the Pillager Level 1 arena with at least 2 players.
Have Player A attack Player B with the normal combat weapon.
Confirm Player B receives damage and can be pushed into the knockdown/death lifecycle by the teammate.
bugs.aiAnalysis: Session/team ownership exists, but the selected artifact does not install a teammate-source exclusion at the damage boundary. Because the ordinary player attack path remains reachable, same-session player damage can feed the map's custom knockdown/revive/death accounting.

relevantCode.reason: Defines ordinary player combat/damage behavior; the selected damage sensor does not exclude same-session player sources.
Owns session/team and custom combat lifecycle logic; no same-session friendly-fire cancellation is installed.

bugs.suggestedFix: Reject player-sourced damage when attacker and victim are members of the same cooperative arena/session, while preserving hostile NPC damage and the existing knockdown/revive lifecycle.
mustPreserve: Hostile NPC damage must continue to enter the normal knockdown/revive/death lifecycle.
Players in unrelated sessions must remain isolated by the existing session ownership model.
